sources.citation: Hamnett, Michael P. 1977. Households on the move: settlement pattern among a group of Eivo and Simeku speakers in Central Bougainville. PhD dissertation, University of Hawaii at Manoa (hdl 10125/9309).
sources.note: Ethnography, no phonology. Only mention: p.34, Eivo village areas were said by informants to differ in 'the speed with which the residents spoke, their manner of pronunciation of certain sounds and their stress patterns' — a dialect-variation remark, no statement of where stress falls. Endnotes pp.43-44 report a 200-item Samarin wordlist cognate count only.

sources.note: Eivo appears only in the West Bougainville Stock listing on p.795 (Rotokas Family: Rotokas dialects 4320, Eivo 1200); no phonological or stress remark on Eivo anywhere in the chapter (a full-text search for stress/accent: no hits).
